description: Anonymous readers see only public rows of a public resource

output.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM `bulletin` AS `bulletin_view` WHERE ((`bulletin_view`.`visibility` = 'public'))

SELECT
  `bulletin_view`.`id` AS `_key`,
  (CASE WHEN `bulletin_view`.`id` IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE (lower(hex(substr(`bulletin_view`.`id`, 1, 4))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`bulletin_view`.`id`, 5, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`bulletin_view`.`id`, 7, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`bulletin_view`.`id`, 9, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`bulletin_view`.`id`, 11, 6)))) END) AS `id`,
  `bulletin_view`.`updated_at` AS `updated_at`,
  (CASE WHEN `bulletin_view`.`owner` IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE (lower(hex(substr(`bulletin_view`.`owner`, 1, 4))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`bulletin_view`.`owner`, 5, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`bulletin_view`.`owner`, 7, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`bulletin_view`.`owner`, 9, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`bulletin_view`.`owner`, 11, 6)))) END) AS `owner`,
  `bulletin_view`.`visibility` AS `visibility`,
  `bulletin_view`.`text` AS `text`
FROM `bulletin` AS `bulletin_view` WHERE ((`bulletin_view`.`visibility` = 'public')) ORDER BY `bulletin_view`.`id` ASC LIMIT ? OFFSET ?
